article.title: Cognizance of offences.
article.content: No court inferior to that of a presidency magistrate or a magistrate of the first class shall try any offence under this Act.
article.html:
292Cognizance of offences.

Section 292 · Chapter XXIII · page 1067 of the Act

No court inferior to that of a presidency magistrate or a magistrate of the first class shall try any offence under this Act.
